description.narrative: Multicountry Americas EMMIE, Malaria, Population Services International (PSI HQ)This program has the following goals: To successfully eliminate autochthonous cases of malaria by 2020.. The objectives of this program are: Improving communication about malaria and advocacy by encouraging strategic partnerships and alliances.. Improving prevention, monitoring and early detection of malaria to contain outbreaks.. Improving timely diagnoses and guaranteed quality treatment.. Promoting Integrated Vector Management (IVM).. Strengthening health systems; strategic planning, monitoring and evaluation; operational research; strengthening the country's capabilities.
